purpose: Pedagogical energy accounting; no company predictions or calibrated reactor simulation.

thermal_sensitivity_case.message: Same plasma Q = 10; different electrical balance.

icf_formulas.target_cost_USD_per_MWh: 3600 * repetition_Hz * target_cost_USD / P_net_MWe; defined only when net is positive

direct_recovery_accounting.required_condition: Same initial/final stored-energy state; full power-electronics and plant boundary.

limitations: No recovery credit for externally supplied heating energy.
No blanket energy multiplication or detailed nuclear heating model.
No transient balance, storage dynamics, maintenance, capital costs or rate-dependent efficiencies.
Inputs are independent for teaching but physically coupled in real designs.
NIF laboratory wall-plug efficiency must never be replaced by a hypothetical commercial-driver assumption.
Negative net output must remain negative in plots.
Reject zero or negative driver efficiency; zero conversion or capture is valid and produces zero gross output. At zero heating, finite Q cannot represent an ignited plasma with finite fusion output.
auxiliary_boundary: All non-driver plant loads. The driver demand calculated separately must not be included again.

inertia_attributed_model.formula: P_net_MW = repetition_Hz * (thermal_efficiency * target_gain * laser_energy_MJ - laser_energy_MJ / laser_efficiency - other_energy_per_shot_MJ)
notes: Arithmetic using the rounded source assumptions differs slightly from company rounded examples.
Illustrative steady-running balance, not measured plant performance or a complete plant engineering model.
Do not force this model to reproduce the separate gain 18/30/45 FAQ scenarios; source assumptions and versions differ.

inertia_faq_version.warning: Requires company-specific plant assumptions; not experimentally demonstrated.

inertia_model_version_note: The live FAQ18/30/45 scenarios and newer >25–43 simulations with 250–1300 MWe estimates use different model snapshots. Do not fit them into one universal line. Preserve source and version labels.

icf_sensitivity_case.change: eta_driver from 0.2 to 0.1 with other teaching inputs unchanged

reaction_energy_split.note: Initial reaction products, not electricity conversion fractions.
